typography.$description: The scale pairs a `*-xs/sm/base/lg/xl/2xl/3xl` step for body text with `label`, `body-sm` (14/22, used for chat and the composer on desktop: `.chat-message-body, .chat-input-editor` set --ui-font-size-base to it), `title-base`, `title-lg` and `headline-sm/base/lg` steps with tighter leading. Serif display text (the home's 'What can I do for you?', the wordmark, the share banner's title, the document previewer's title) uses fontFamily.serif at these sizes.

density.$description: Manus's density scale: row heights, radii, paddings and gaps the sidebar, menus, composer and chat read through var(). The desktop app offers Standard and Compact (`html.is-desktop[data-interface-density]`); `compact` and `standardDesktop` in $extensions are those overrides, the web default is the $value.
